The Save America's Rural Hospitals Act (H.R. 3684) pours $50B into rural healthcare through the Rural Health Transformation Program—but let’s be clear. While stabilizing facilities like Genesis Hospital matters, Section 106’s wage index adjustments and Section 113’s CAH designations risk creating bureaucratic slush funds. The bill allocates $10B annually through 2030, with half distributed via CMS formulas ripe for manipulation.

Senator Crapo’s claim of "protecting taxpayer dollars" rings hollow when Section 401(g)(9) allows states to divert funds into undefined "innovative models of care" without strict auditing. Rural hospitals need targeted relief, not blank checks for D.C.-approved pet projects.

The real test? Whether this $50B actually stops closures like the 151 facilities already shuttered since 2025—or becomes another line item in Washington’s endless waste ledger.

Congressional oversight and public scrutiny are overdue—see the full breakdown: https://t.co/PnIdKMXJXt
